title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, as amended to 1 July 2026

rules.rule_text: The height of letters in the declaration shall not be less than 1 mm height and when blown, formed, molded, embossed or perforated, the height of letters shall not be less than 2 mm.
rules.message: MRP numeral is below the minimum height of 1 mm.

rules.rule_text: Provided that the width of the letter or numeral shall not be less than one third of its height, except in the case of numeral `1' and letters (i), (I) and (l);
rules.message: MRP numerals are condensed below one third of their height.

rules.rule_text: The height of any numeral in the declaration required under these rules, on the principal display panel shall not be less than, (i) as shown in Table-I, if the net quantity is declared in terms of weight or volume.
rules.message: Net quantity numeral is below the minimum height required for this pack size.

rules.rule_text: Provided that the area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information (a) above and below by a space equal to at least the height of the numeral in the declaration, and (b) to the left and right by a space at least twice the height of numeral in the declaration.
rules.message: Printed matter intrudes into the clear space required around the net quantity declaration.

rules.rule_text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e mail address, if available, of the person who can be or the office which can be, contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
rules.message: Consumer care contact details are missing.
